name: Highperch Venom Sac
summary: At Highperch, wyverns carry venom that buyers seek across Kalimdor. Their sacs draw trade even where the beasts do not fly.

sections.title: A Potent Harvest
sections.body: Wild wyverns nest among Highperch's crags in Thousand Needles. Their barbed tails deliver venom that can paralyze or kill prey. The Horde often domesticates wyverns as wind riders. Across Kalimdor, alchemists, hunters, and merchants pay well for the venom sacs.

sections.title: A Faraway Buyer
sections.body: Highperch venom reaches buyers far from central Kalimdor. In Theramore, the high elf Fiora Longears pays well for fresh sacs gathered from Highperch broods. She seeks sacs swollen with venom, most often found on young wyverns or fertile females. Far from their desert home, she trades these dangerous reagents.

faq.q: What creatures carry these venom sacs?
faq.answer: Wild wyverns at Highperch carry the sacs. They include Highperch Wyverns, Patriarchs, Consorts, and the matriarch Heartrazor.

faq.q: Why does Fiora Longears want this venom in Theramore?
faq.answer: Fiora Longears knows wyvern venom is highly valued in some trading circles, sometimes more than the mounts. She pays travelers bound for Highperch in Thousand Needles to bring back intact sacs for trade.

faq.q: Are all wyvern venom sacs identical?
faq.answer: The sacs vary in potency and volume. The most prized are swollen with poison, usually those of young wyverns or fertile breeding females.

faq.q: How does the Horde utilize these wyverns compared to the Alliance?
faq.answer: The Horde captures and breeds wyverns as aerial mounts and scouts called wind riders. Independent traders and Alliance contacts without domestic taming networks harvest the beasts for their lethal reagents.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can find some of Kalimdor's most potent natural toxins in the concentrated paralyzing venom of untamed wyverns in Thousand Needles.
As an Alliance member, you can strike at Highperch's nests for valuable trade reagents and cull wild wyverns the Horde might otherwise capture and break as mounts.
